svg.title: Every individual expanded public slowdown over 20%
svg.desc: Public development only; final independent benchmark failed; no final winner. CPython, C, Rust, and Zig ran the same 4096 calibration-only public cases, 13 paired trials, and 2000 bootstrap draws. Every one of the 2,548 observed substantial slowdowns; no case is hidden. Public manifest SHA-256 4b541eaa1602855aeb67655c8732635d4c951a61ca2fae37f395a1b080a78d1e; public summary SHA-256 2f478bd2bbca7af5c635d9d40ba8ffa41a13f7a0ab92b2ab09d1bf3d2eed32a8. Final speed, final memory, and final candidate ranking: NOT MEASURED. Final winner: NONE.

C: 449/4,096 cases more than 20% slower than CPython
Zig: 797/4,096 cases more than 20% slower than CPython
Rust: 1,302/4,096 cases more than 20% slower than CPython
Every measured substantial loss is named individually; bars use a zero-preserving logarithmic visual scale. Final regressions: NOT MEASURED.
